title: Azzurro Sky | KEY.co
description_expanded: The rooftop oasis is a showstopper, complete with a sparkling pool and plush loungers where you can soak up the sun or toast the sunset over the Gulf. Inside, elegant king suites, a custom bunk room, and multiple entertainment spaces create the perfect blend of privacy and togetherness. This exceptional property combines premium amenities—including an elevator, dual laundry rooms, and an outdoor grilling station—with a prime location near Seagrove's finest dining, shopping, and attractions. Whether savoring panoramic views, enjoying the Gulf breeze on your private balcony, or lounging by the pool, this home promises an unforgettable coastal getaway. This Gulf-front retreat in the heart of Seagrove Beach is a luxurious haven designed for relaxation and indulgence. With four bedrooms, eight bathrooms, and accommodations for up to 14 guests, this four-story masterpiece offers breathtaking Gulf views, direct beach access, and a private rooftop pool. Every detail is crafted for comfort and style, from the chef's kitchen with high-end Wolf appliances to the spacious living areas with expansive balconies overlooking the water. Thoughtful touches like a six-seater golf cart, six adult bikes, and beach chair setups ensure guests enjoy effortless exploration and seaside leisure along 30A.

Features: Outdoor Pool Heated pool Outdoor grill
Guests assume all risk for use of pools
